reviews.text: Good south indian food

Price-wise, it's a little expensive. I ordered 2 plates of idly and 1 veg fried rice, and the total bill came to ₹268 including taxes. The veg fried rice alone costs ₹142, but the quantity doesn't justify the price. They also charged an extra ₹17 for parcel packing, yet the food was packed in a very lightweight aluminium container. Overall, the pricing doesn't seem worth it for the quantity and packaging provided.

Excellent North Indian & Chinese Food! A Must-Try!

We recently ordered food from this restaurant for a small family function, and the experience was exceptional from start to finish. Everything—taste, quality, service, and value—exceeded expectations.

The standout feature is undoubtedly the quality of ingredients. The restaurant proudly displays the brands of oil and ghee used in their cooking—a rare and thoughtful touch that reflects their transparency and commitment to quality. You can truly taste the difference. The vegetables are fresh, and the food feels light yet packed with authentic flavors. Both the North Indian and Chinese dishes were absolutely delicious, prepared with care and consistency.

Portion sizes are quite generous, making it great value for money considering the reasonable prices. Their North Indian-style samosas are a real treat—crispy on the outside, perfectly spiced inside, and just the right balance of flavor and crunch.

The staff here are equally impressive—friendly, polite, and genuinely attentive. They patiently helped us choose dishes based on our preferences, making the ordering process seamless and enjoyable.

The dining area is clean and spacious, offering comfortable seating suitable for families and groups. The only slight inconvenience is parking, as it’s limited to roadside spaces, which can be tricky during busy hours.

Overall, this is one of the best places around for fresh, tasty, and quality North Indian and Chinese food. Highly recommended for anyone who values flavor, hygiene, and honest cooking!

Visited Kanhaji, located at B-7, SLN Shopping Complex, 842/10, Kogilu Main Rd, Maruthi Nagar, Kogilu, Bengaluru. I tried their Butter Pav Bhaji, which cost 115 INR. The flavor was moderate—neither overly impressive nor disappointing. I also sampled the Butter Masala Dosa priced at 70 INR, but I was surprised to notice that they didn’t seem to use actual butter; it tasted more like a regular dosa cooked in oil. The overall taste was just average and didn’t meet my expectations. Even after inquiring about the lack of butter, the staff insisted that they had indeed used butter, which felt misleading. Additionally, I decided to try their tea, which cost 15 INR, but I would recommend skipping it. The tea was quite watery and lacked any real flavor. As for parking, it's possible to park bikes along the street, but I would advise against bringing a car since there is no parking available on the main road, making it inconvenient for those driving.

reviews.author: Gaurav Nagar
reviews.text:
A good place to have food with family & friends far from the city crowd ( at least till now), focused on North Indian food, nice hygienic with clean washroom. Had paav bhaji & Masala Dosa with family 👪 it was fresh & reach in teste.

You might find it a little expensive but still decent.
